hardness.label: Very Hard
hardness.intro: The City of Round Rock's 2025 water quality report put average hardness at 249 mg/L, about 14.6 GPG, and calls it very hard water. Click a neighbourhood to see what that means for your home.
hardness.reportNote: The City of Round Rock's 2025 report gave a citywide average of 249 mg/L (14.6 GPG), and its results table lists a range of 100 to 358 ppm. The U.S. Geological Survey rates over 180 mg/L as "Very Hard."
hardness.footnote: Hardness is the City of Round Rock's citywide figure from its 2025 report; it can read higher or lower at your tap, and it does not cover private wells or any neighbourhood served by another utility.
